description: Credential stored in plaintext configuration (hardcoded_api_key)
remediation: Rotate the credential, then load it at runtime from a secrets manager (e.g. AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault) instead of configuration.

description: Credential stored in plaintext configuration (connection_string_credentials)
remediation: Rotate the credential, then load it at runtime from a secrets manager (e.g. AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault) instead of configuration.

description: API endpoint accepts unauthenticated requests
remediation: Require authentication (OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, mTLS, or rotated API keys).

description: API served over plaintext HTTP
remediation: Serve over HTTPS with TLS 1.2+ and redirect or refuse plaintext HTTP.

description: Credential stored in plaintext configuration (hardcoded_password)
remediation: Rotate the credential, then load it at runtime from a secrets manager (e.g. AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault) instead of configuration.

description: Credential stored in plaintext configuration (hardcoded_api_key)
remediation: Rotate the credential, then load it at runtime from a secrets manager (e.g. AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault) instead of configuration.

description: Storage location allows public access
remediation: Block public access and grant read access only to specific principals.

description: Model endpoint does not validate inputs before inference
remediation: Validate type, schema, size, and ranges before inference; isolate untrusted text from instructions.

description: Policy grants wildcard ('*') actions
remediation: Apply least privilege: enumerate only required actions (e.g. s3:GetObject).

description: Policy applies to all resources ('*')
remediation: Scope resources to specific ARNs (e.g. arn:aws:s3:::my-bucket/*).

description: requests 2.25.0 is affected by CVE-2023-32681
remediation: Upgrade requests to >= 2.31.0 (or latest) and review CVE-2023-32681.

description: flask 1.1.2 is affected by CVE-2023-30861
remediation: Upgrade flask to >= 2.2.5 (or latest) and review CVE-2023-30861.

description: django 2.2.0 is affected by CVE-2019-14232
remediation: Upgrade django to >= 2.2.4 (or latest) and review CVE-2019-14232.

description: Data at rest is not encrypted (backup_encryption)
remediation: Enable encryption at rest with a managed KMS key.

description: Data at rest is not encrypted (encryption)
remediation: Enable encryption at rest with a managed KMS key.

description: Data capture stores raw inference requests/responses (likely PII) without KMS encryption
remediation: Set DataCaptureConfig.KmsKeyId, restrict the S3 prefix, and set a retention policy.

description: Notebook has direct internet access, bypassing VPC egress controls
remediation: Set DirectInternetAccess=Disabled and route egress through the VPC.

description: Model versions are not tracked, so a tampered or regressed model cannot be detected or rolled back
remediation: Track models in a registry (e.g. MLflow) with immutable versions and artifact hashes.

description: Model performance and drift are not monitored
remediation: Monitor accuracy/drift and alert on threshold breaches.

description: API endpoint does not enforce rate limiting
remediation: Enforce per-client rate limits at the gateway or application.

description: API requests are not logged
remediation: Enable request/audit logging with PII masking and central retention.

description: Role can be assumed without multi-factor authentication
remediation: Require MFA via policy condition aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent=true for human-assumable roles.

description: Data access is not logged
remediation: Enable access logging and ship logs to central storage.

description: Stored artifacts can be overwritten without history (model tampering risk)
remediation: Enable versioning and integrity checks (hash/signature) for model artifacts.

description: Endpoint storage volume not encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key
remediation: Set KmsKeyId on the EndpointConfig.

description: Model container can make outbound network calls (exfiltration path for a malicious model)
remediation: Set EnableNetworkIsolation=true on the Model.

description: Notebook users have root on the instance
remediation: Set RootAccess=Disabled.

description: Endpoint is not attached to a private VPC
remediation: Provide VpcConfig with private subnets and restrictive security groups.
